annotations.title: Live planning constraints for a decorating job postcode

description: Looks up, live from official open data, what applies at the customer's postcode before exterior painting, a change of colour or finish, painting unpainted brick or stone, or stripping historic paint: listed buildings, conservation areas, Article 4 directions and World Heritage Sites (planning.data.gov.uk, England, councils that publish). Returns each constraint found with its source link, a plain `exterior_colour_change` answer, what each constraint means for decorating, and the council and nation. A constraint not found is not proof of none: the answer says so. Example: {"postcode":"BA1 2LR"}.
name: property_check
title: Live planning constraints for a decorating job postcode
